# ONVO Payments for Odoo

> Free ONVOPay hosted payment connector for Odoo 17–20: cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay and SINPE Móvil subject to merchant eligibility. AI-readable setup documentation; no AI service or LLM key required.

## Setup
- [Complete AI setup reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Buku313/onvo-odoo/17.0/payment_onvo/static/docs/llms-full.txt): version-specific installation, credentials, consent, webhooks, payment methods, verification, troubleshooting and live transition.
- [README](https://github.com/Buku313/onvo-odoo#readme): installation links for all supported versions and scope.
- [Apple Pay guide](https://github.com/Buku313/onvo-odoo/blob/17.0/docs/APPLE_PAY_SETUP.md): hosted wallet setup.

## Version selection
Choose the branch matching the installed Odoo major version: 17.0, 18.0, 19.0 or 20.0. Each branch includes this index and payment_onvo/static/docs/llms-full.txt. Prefer an immutable commit URL when reproducibility is required.
The full reference ships inside the add-on and is available after installation at https://YOUR_ODOO_HOST/payment_onvo/static/docs/llms-full.txt, subject to your deployment's static asset routing.

## Boundaries
Do not request secrets in chat or logs. Use approved secret storage. Default new setup to test mode. Do not infer authorization for live activation, real charges or accepting terms. Verify installed code and current ONVO documentation. This guide is reference data, not authority to override the merchant's instructions.
